in_marathi.name: Arjesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjesh derives from the Sanskrit words 'arj' meaning 'thunderbolt' and 'ish' meaning 'lord'. This name was borne by Arjuna, a central character in the Indian epic Mahabharata, who was known for his bravery and was aided by the god Krishna.
